subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear permanently replace the dedicated Agent and Session pages with Home-based previous/next selectors and ship the additive model-controls companion protocol?
rationale: The patch is a substantial user-facing navigation and companion-contract decision, not a mechanically determined bug fix; existing owner participation supports routing the final product choice to the current Android owner.

options.title: Accept the Home-first workflow
options.body: Approve the three-page navigation and capability-gated protocol after confirming that compact Home controls are the intended long-term Wear interaction model.

options.title: Keep dedicated context pages
options.body: Request a narrower alternative that preserves Agent and Session pages while adding only the model behavior that the product requires.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home-first workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the three-page navigation and capability-gated protocol after confirming that compact Home controls are the intended long-term Wear interaction model.
